questions: How many bars and cooldowns did you measure on the 2.0 nm AlAs wafer, and how many showed a zero-field diode effect that reverses with [100] preparation?
Why were the others set aside, if any were?

What is the field at the sample at nominal H = 0 after each excursion, including any out-of-plane part from sample tilt, and how was the magnet's remanent field measured or compensated? Were the [010] and [100] bars on the same chip and mount?
Did you measure η against small applied fields near zero, in plane and out of plane, after each preparation, and the same protocol on an Al bar without CuMnAs?
